artifact.name: go-cask object browser
artifact.purpose: Browse, filter, sort, page, and inspect content-addressed objects.
constraints: One flat operational workspace, not a dashboard.
Use live derived state from one normalized object collection.
When no object is selected, show no inspector values.
Use real button controls for tabs and actions.
Status is a real table column rendered as a compact semantic pill, not an absent value.
Identity exposes Type only. The hash function is omitted from the product, so a hash never carries a name, label, or prefix: no algorithm row in Identity and no algorithm token in any displayed hash.

derivedColors.quietHoverBg: color-mix(in oklch, fg 4%, surface) — tab and reference-row hover
derivedColors.verifyHoverFill: color-mix(in oklch, accent 86%, fg) — fill and border
derivedColors.note: Status pill fills are literal oklch values, not tokens, in the reference implementation.

geometry.rowPadding: 8px horizontal and vertical; header row 7px vertical
geometry.clearButtonSize: 30x30 effective (inline override of the 20x20 stylesheet rule), radius 3px, 5px from the right edge
geometry.definitionList: 96px label column, 5px row gap, 10px column gap
geometry.radius: 5px inputs and brand mark, 4px buttons, 3px pills and quiet rows, 4px on the two top corners of tabs (4px 4px 0 0; the bottom border is the active indicator)

content: 20x20 rounded fg square brand mark CA (9.9px mono, surface text)
Verify solid accent button pushed right with margin-left auto

regions.element: form, so Reset is a native form reset

regions.structure: flex column; table-wrap flex 1 with min-height 0; pager is a pinned footer
regions.background: table-wrap paints bg, table paints surface

overflow.tableWrap: both axes; sticky header; bg token shows on unused scroll surface

mobile.workspace: one column; list first then inspector; workspace height auto with min-height calc(100vh - 93px)

search.leftIcon: ⌕ glyph, muted, 19.8px, absolutely positioned left 9px, vertically centered, pointer-events none
search.rightAction: × clear button appears only when query is non-empty; clears only query, refocuses search, retains other filters
search.matches: substring against the bare digest or the type, case-insensitive; the reference implementation lowercases the query and compares against the lowercase hash and type
search.referenceOverride: the reference implementation carries inline overrides on the wrapper (262px) and the clear button (30x30), which win over the stylesheet; the effective metrics above are authoritative

reset.element: button type=reset inside the filter form
reset.hover: 12% accent mixed into surface with 4px radius
reset.effect: native form reset restores every filter and the query to its default, hides the clear affordance, and returns to page 1

objectTable.style: fixed-layout table-layout, dense, min-width 700px, mono data; unused scroll surface uses bg token; cells nowrap with ellipsis overflow

columns.label: Hash
columns.display: first 8 hex characters of the digest, then an ellipsis; the digest is shown bare, with nothing prefixed or appended

columns.label: Type
columns.display: lowercase, muted; stays muted on a selected row

columns.label: Status
columns.display: semantic pill, capitalized via text-transform, rendered as a real cell between Refs and Written

header.initialSort: Hash ascending: the hash header starts aria-sort=ascending with its active ▲ button aria-pressed=true, and every other header starts aria-sort=none
header.sortControl: one 14x14 arrow button immediately right of the label, 4px gap, right-aligned in the numeric columns; active column shows ▲ ascending or ▼ descending; click toggles direction on the same column; selecting a different column starts ascending; aria-sort on the th and aria-pressed on the button

rows.selected: rowSelected with a 2px dark leading inset (55% fg) and full fg text
rows.keyboard: Enter or Space selects the focused row
rows.hashDisplay: first 8 hex characters of the digest followed by an ellipsis; shown bare, with no prefix

objectTable.empty: One centered row spanning all six columns: No objects match the current filters.

statusLabels.shape: compact borderless 3px-radius pill, min-height 19px, 1px 6px padding, 700 10px text, text-transform capitalize

pagination.placement: bottom of object list, pinned below table scroll area, bg surface, 7px 14px, 12px gap
pagination.control: 27px bordered square, mono 12.1px; hover raises the border to fg and the fill to bg; unavailable controls are disabled at 0.4 opacity with a not-allowed cursor
pagination.summaryFormat: matched count is locale formatted; total bytes use whole MB above 1 MiB, whole KB above 1 KiB, else bytes

verifyButton.default: solid accent fill, surface text, height 28px, radius 4px, 12.1px 650
verifyButton.hover: accent darkened toward fg (86% accent mix) for fill and border
verifyButton.working: disabled at 0.6 opacity with wait cursor, label Verifying…
verifyButton.done: brief Verified state, restores to Verify after 1.2s
verifyButton.note: the reference implementation computes all results synchronously, so the working label is never observable; keep the disabled working state for an asynchronous verify

splitter.role: vertical drag separator, role=separator, aria-orientation vertical, aria-valuemin 280, aria-valuemax 560, aria-valuenow current width, tabindex 0
splitter.drag: pointer capture; width = start width + (start x - current x), clamped to 280px-560px; written to the --inspector-width custom property on the workspace
splitter.keyboard: Left/Right steps 20px; Home sets min; End sets max
splitter.visible: 4px border tone; accent on hover, drag, or focus
splitter.hitTarget: extends 5px on both sides via ::after; touch-action none

header.label: Object, micro uppercase mono heading, with a compact Back button on the same row
header.hash: full selected digest in mono, shown bare with no prefix, wrapping anywhere
header.copy: 25px bordered icon button visible only when a hash exists; ⧉ default, ✓ for 1.2s on success; aria-label Copy full object hash then Hash copied; falls back to a hidden textarea and execCommand when the clipboard API is unavailable
header.back: 22px compact button, disabled until an object was opened from a reference; restores the preceding inspector selection

tabs.implementation: button tablist with arrow-key navigation (Left/Right wrap, Home/End), aria-selected and roving tabindex, exactly one active panel
tabs.active: foreground text, 650 weight, 2px accent bottom border

sections.name: Identity
sections.rule: Type is the only Identity property. No hash-function row, label, or prefix exists anywhere in the inspector.

metadata.layout: two-column definition list, label column 96px, value flexible left aligned; 5px row gap and 10px column gap; 20px section margin
metadata.timestamp: RFC 3339 UTC timestamp with milliseconds: YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ss.SSSZ, derived from the stored epoch
metadata.status: current point-in-time verification result rendered as a semantic status pill
metadata.empty: Keep headings and property labels, clear all values

references.row: button, 13.2px mono, 7px gap, 2px 3px padding, 3px radius; direction arrow, uppercase reference-kind pill, shortened hash
references.kindPill: reference-soft fill, reference blue text, 2px 5px padding, 3px radius
references.by: incoming references, arrow ←, kind manifest; the row is reachable by keyboard and selects the target object, pushing history
references.outEmpty: This object references no other objects.
references.empty: Show no reference items when no object is selected

bytes.content: first 128 object bytes as eight rows of offset, 16 hex bytes, and ASCII; rendered from a deterministic hex preview derived from the digest
bytes.row: 8-digit hex offset, two spaces, 16 space-separated hex pairs, two spaces, ASCII in pipes with non-printables as dots
bytes.empty: No content when no object is selected

object.hash: content address digest as 64 lowercase hex characters; shown bare everywhere in the interface, with no hash-function name, label, or prefix in the table, inspector, reference rows, byte view, copy target, or accessible names
object.size: human byte string (B/KiB/MiB); derive byte count for comparison separately
object.writtenAt: epoch timestamp used for sort and RFC 3339 derivation
object.written: human readable age derived from writtenAt: h ago below 24 hours, then d ago
object.verificationResult: ephemeral result in a session map, initially unverified; Verify marks refsBy above zero verified and refsBy zero orphaned

rules: Filtering, searching, or changing page size resets to page 1.
Filter the normalized object collection, sort it, then take the current page slice.
Clamp the current page to the available page count on every render, so a shrinking result set never shows an empty page.

Size comparisons use integer bytes parsed from the display string; Written comparisons use writtenAt timestamps; Refs comparisons use integers; Hash, Type, and Status use locale-aware text comparison.
Verify updates the current session verification result for all objects: refsBy above zero becomes verified, refsBy zero becomes orphaned.
Unverified and Corrupt filters are available; no objects match until corresponding verification results exist.
Total size in pagination equals the sum of all currently matched object byte sizes, not just the current page.
No matches clears selection and every inspector value, reference list, byte row, and copy action.
When matches exist and the selected object is not in the filtered result set, select the first matching object and update inspector data.
Any selected row visually reflects selection with a leading inset and updates inspector data.
Opening an object from a reference row pushes the previous selection onto a history stack; Back pops it and enables only when the stack is non-empty.
Do not render an unbounded result list; paginate before DOM/server response rendering.

accessibility.focus: 2px accent ring on all focusable controls; inputs and selects use 2px offset, compact row controls (sort arrows, pager buttons, copy, reference rows, history back) use 1px offset, and table rows use a 2px inset outline
accessibility.contrast: All quiet hover states keep foreground text at or above its resting contrast: muted text moves to fg, and fills move rather than the text color
accessibility.table: Expose column headers, aria-sort state, semantic status-label text, and selected row state; rows are keyboard focusable with Enter/Space selection
accessibility.tabs: Use button controls with tab role, aria-selected state, associated panels, and arrow-key roving navigation
accessibility.splitter: Expose separator role and vertical orientation with aria-valuemin, aria-valuemax, aria-valuenow, and keyboard resizing (arrows, Home, End)
accessibility.controls: Sort buttons expose aria-pressed plus a direction-bearing label; pager buttons and the clear button carry aria-labels; the search field and every select carry aria-labels
accessibility.copy: Accessible name must state Copy full object hash and change to Hash copied for confirmation

implementationGuidance.client: Use one deterministic 512-object store and derive view state. Avoid duplicate fallback DOM or stale handlers. Treat verification results as session state, not intrinsic object data. The reference implementation builds five data cells per row and then inserts the status cell before the Written cell, and patches the empty row to span six columns; a port should emit all six cells directly.
implementationGuidance.server: Represent query, filters, sort, page, page size, selected hash, and active tab in the URL. Return the table and pager as one fragment and inspector as a selected-object fragment.
implementationGuidance.portability: This document specifies behavior and styling independently of framework. It can be implemented with SSR templates, htmx, React, native desktop, or another UI technology.
